properties.name: David of Sassoun
properties.summary: The Armenian national epic tells of four generations of heroes from Sassoun. David, the greatest, wielded a magical sword and rode a supernatural horse. He defeated the tyrannical Msra Melik and liberated his people. His grandson Mher was trapped inside a rock for eternity, emerging only when the world becomes worthy.

properties.name: Birth of Vahagn the Dragon-Slayer
properties.summary: Vahagn was born from cosmic fire — heaven and earth labored, the sea turned red, and from a reed stalk fire emerged, forming a golden-haired youth with eyes like suns. He slew dragons (vishaps) and stole hay from the Milky Way (the 'Straw-Thief's Way' in Armenian). He was Armenia's war god.
